activities.title: Exploring Kranji Marshes Nature Park
activities.description: Join experienced guides from NSS Bird Group in exploring the core area of Kranji Marshes Nature Park. The paths and hides here offer excellent views across the freshwater marshes. activities.title: Planting Trees along the Rail Corridor
activities.description: Spend a rewarding morning planting trees along the Rail Corridor and help create a thriving green corridor in the heart of Singapore. This is more than just planting trees – it is about connecting forests, mangroves, and urban greenery into a continuous lifeline for wildlife, providing food, shelter, and space...

activities.title: Exploring Woodlands Botanic Gardens
activities.description: Join our guides from the Butterfly & Insect Group and Bird Group to explore Woodlands Botanic Gardens. At least 15 resident butterflies have been recorded here including the Common Rose, Common Birdwing, Black-veined Tiger, Julia Longwing, Peacock Royal and Leopard Lacewing. activities.title: Leisurely Walk through Pasir Ris Mangrove
activities.description: Join our Nature Stewards volunteers on a leisurely walk through the Pasir Ris Mangrove and uncover the secrets of this habitat. activities.title: Walk through Windsor Nature Park
activities.description: Join our Nature Stewards volunteers on a leisurely walk through Windsor Nature Park and explore the wonders of Singapore’s secondary forest.
